description: Voice-search retrieval eval. Each query is the raw utterance as the recogniser would hand it to VoiceSearch.search(). 'expected' = acceptable block ids (any-of). expectAll = occurrences of a repeated phrase (recall@3 is also computed). expectContent = case-insensitive regex that the sliced text of the matching hit must contain. Ground truth was written by reading the sample documents, not by looking at system output.

pt-synthetic.note: Supplementary, author-written Portuguese blocks (NOT one of the sample documents). The shipped samples are English-only, so this is the only way to exercise the PT tokenizer/stemmer/parser on a PT document.
